cases.case_label: Rare AluYc3 in MSH4 intron (patient P20, TNBC)
cases.disease: Hereditary breast and/or ovarian cancer (candidate susceptibility)
cases.mechanism_detail: Rare AluYc3 insertion in MSH4 (text says intron 3, Table 1 says intron 17 of 19) in a TNBC patient. WTS and RT-PCR found no alternative splicing caused by the insertion; proposed only as a rare candidate susceptibility factor in a DNA repair-related gene.
cases.quote: An Alu element insertion in intron 3 of the MSH4 gene seq[GRCh38] der(1)ins(1;?)(p31.1;?) NC_000001.11:g.75,894,801_75,894,802insAlu was detected in patient P20, who was diagnosed with TNBC.

cases.disease: Hereditary breast and/or ovarian cancer (candidate susceptibility)
cases.mechanism_detail: Rare AluYb9 insertion in MTOR intron 6 in a Luminal-A breast cancer patient. WTS and RT-PCR found no alternative splicing caused by the insertion; proposed only as a rare candidate susceptibility factor in a DNA repair-related gene.
cases.quote: In patient P21, who has been diagnosed with Luminal-A BC, an Alu insertion in intron 6 of the MTOR gene seq[GRCh38] der(1)ins(1;?)(p36.22;?) NC_000001.11:g.11,253,687_11,253,688insAlu was detected.

cases.disease: Hereditary breast and/or ovarian cancer (candidate susceptibility)
cases.mechanism_detail: Rare AluYa5 insertion in POLB intron 2 in a Luminal-A breast cancer patient. WTS and RT-PCR found no alternative splicing caused by the insertion; proposed only as a rare candidate susceptibility factor in a DNA repair-related gene.

cases.case_label: Rare L1 in POLK exon 15 (patient P23)
cases.disease: Hereditary breast and/or ovarian cancer (candidate susceptibility)
cases.mechanism_detail: Rare L1 insertion in POLK exon 15 (last exon) in a patient with ovarian and Luminal-A breast cancer; presumed to disrupt the gene but WTS/RT-PCR showed no splicing change and no functional effect was demonstrated.
cases.quote: The L1 element insertion in exon 15 of the POLK gene seq[GRCh38] der(5)ins(5;?)(q13.3;?) NC_000005.10:g.75,598,292_75,598,293insL1 was identified in patient P23, who has been diagnosed with OC and Luminal-A BC.

cases.case_label: Rare L1 in SPIDR intron 8 (patient P1)
cases.disease: Hereditary breast and/or ovarian cancer (candidate susceptibility)
cases.mechanism_detail: Rare L1 insertion (ORF2 sequence at junction, confirmed by OGM) in SPIDR intron 8 in a TNBC patient who also carries a nonsense variant elsewhere. WTS and RT-PCR found no alternative splicing caused by the insertion; proposed only as a rare candidate susceptibility factor in a DNA repair-related gene.
cases.quote: Patient P1, who was diagnosed with TNBC, carries an L1 element insertion in intron 8 of the SPIDR gene, seq[GRCh38] der(8)ins(8;?)(q11.21;?) NC_000008.11:g.47,564,681_47,564,682insL1[1,293].

cases.quote: An Alu element insertion in intron 3 of the TP63 gene, seq[GRCh38] der(3)ins(3;?)(q28;?) NC_000003.12:g.189,758,057_189,758,058insAlu was found in patient P24, who has been diagnosed with Luminal-A BC.
